exposure: placental nucleotide variations on eNOS gene
placental nucleotide variations on VEGFA gene
placental nucleotide variations on FLT-1 gene
cohort: The study included placental tissue from 88 controls and 82 cases of pregnant Latin American women.
finding: Placental SNV rs2010963 in the VEGFA gene was a risk factor for preeclampsia, while a specific allele combination (T, G, G, C, C, C for rs2070744, rs1799983, rs2010963, rs3025039, rs699947 and rs4769613) showed a potential protective effect against preeclampsia in Latin American women.
